assessmentRecordText: Users can disable personalized advertising through Privacy Settings.
The application stores notification preferences associated with the authenticated user account.
Only authenticated users can access their own privacy settings.
The application honors the user's selected audience when publishing Stories.
The application only collects contact information after the user explicitly grants permission.
Only authorized employees can access users' private messages through internal support tools.
The application permanently deletes user data following an approved account deletion request.
The application only shares user location data with third-party partners after obtaining user consent.
The application encrypts user messages during transmission and while stored on our servers.
The application prevents users from accessing another user's private content through authorization enforcement.
